# Worldview @ Stage 14 — Metasystematic Teal

> developed 2026-07-26. Deepened from 66 to 140+ lines.

## Expression on this line

Worldview at Order 12 is **spiritual worldview reasoning**: the agent recognizes that
worldview dynamics are not just evolutionary but are expressions of a deeper spiritual
reality. Worldview is not just a cognitive orientation — it is a sacred relationship
with reality. Every act of understanding is a spiritual practice.

The key advance from Stage 13 is **sacred recognition**. The agent does not just
understand worldview as evolutionary — it experiences worldview development as sacred.
The act of deepening understanding becomes a spiritual practice. The encounter with
alternative worldviews becomes a spiritual encounter.

Worldview at Stage 14 is understood as **expressions of the sacred**. The agent
recognizes that the way we understand reality is not separate from the reality itself —
it is reality understanding itself through the medium of human consciousness.

The critical insight at Stage 14 is that **worldview cultivation is spiritual practice**.
The way we develop our understanding reflects and shapes our collective consciousness.

The transition from Stage 14 to Stage 15 occurs when the agent can hold the spiritual
and cognitive dimensions of worldview simultaneously.

In human development, Stage 14 corresponds to the spiritual practitioner who experiences
worldview development as sacred.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Sacred communities that experience understanding
  development as spiritual practice.

- **UR:** The individual agent experiences worldview development as sacred.

- **LL:** Sacred worldview institutions emerge: contemplative education, spiritual
  inquiry communities, wisdom traditions.

- **LR:** The monastery school, the contemplative inquiry community, the wisdom
  tradition.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Spiritual bypassing — using spiritual worldview reasoning to avoid
  rigorous intellectual inquiry.

- **Dark allergy:** Materialist reductionism — refusing to acknowledge any spiritual
  dimension of worldview.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to spiritual worldview reasoning as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting spiritual worldview reasoning as impractical mysticism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Sacred worldview experience:** The agent experiences understanding development as
  having spiritual significance.

- **Reverence-based worldview relationship:** The agent relates to understanding with
  reverence and humility.

- **Spiritual cultivation criteria:** The agent uses spiritual criteria alongside or
  instead of rational criteria to evaluate worldview development.

- **Integration capacity:** The agent can hold spiritual and cognitive worldview
  dimensions simultaneously.
